evidenceRole: A fresh, precommitted development-validation-test experiment on the previously unused text-only LongMemEval-V2 static-environment population. The public benchmark is a method-validation proxy, not a final programming-agent claim.

queryConditionedRetrieval.borrowedPrinciple: Treat post-retrieval memory reuse as a separate optimization surface while holding retrieval candidates, target state, model, and decoding fixed.
queryConditionedRetrieval.scopeDifference: D12 is a deterministic bounded sidecar over MemoryCore Top-40 candidates and uses no trained rewriter.

trajectoryWiki.borrowedPrinciple: Route evidence through trajectory ownership and preserve source snapshots instead of flattening all history into unrelated snippets.
trajectoryWiki.scopeDifference: D12 injects at most one provenance-bearing candidate and does not build an unbounded wiki.

lratBoundary.notBorrowed: LRAT mines trajectories to train a retriever. Base-retriever retraining is outside the challenge scope, so D12 keeps MemoryCore FTS5 unchanged.

d11NegativeResult.finding: D11 preserved bounded Base evidence and reduced test tokens by 20.84%, but changed no direct-support outcome on the untouched test split.
d11NegativeResult.designResponse: D12 changes evidence accessibility by using one Base Top-40 item that Base did not inject, while retaining every D11 certificate.

consumedDesignDecision.boundary: The selected policy used only previously consumed procedure questions. Its one-case gain is a design signal and cannot confirm D12.

split.readOrder: Freeze candidate and harness; run development Base then candidate; run validation only after a committed development admission; run test only after committed development and validation admissions.

baseline.engine: MemoryCore SQLite L0 FTS5 through executeConversationSearch
baseline.queryTransform: Remove final-answer formatting instructions only; retain the substantive question and options.

candidate.selectionRule: Reproduce D11. Among existing Top-40 raw candidates owned by the selected D11 trajectory and absent from exact Base, exclude semantic duplicates and candidates outside fixed evidence bounds. Select one by descending novel semantic-span count, ascending novel characters, ascending FTS rank, then stable id.
candidate.baseCertificate: The complete D11 capsule is a byte-identical prefix of the expansion capsule; every Base semantic value, source marker, anchor, action, and unrelated Base item remains covered.
candidate.externalCertificate: Every selected novel external semantic value is verbatim, in source order, and accompanied by its raw-memory id.
candidate.costCertificate: Total items and tokens cannot exceed exact Base. External evidence may consume D11 savings but cannot enlarge Base injection.
candidate.ordinaryNoop: D11 ineligibility returns Base. No external candidate, no novelty, bounded extraction overflow, capsule overflow, or insufficient remaining budget returns the exact D11 context.
candidate.hardFallback: Disabled, missing procedure index, missing feedback table, missing raw candidate pool, feedback overflow, timeout, corruption, or impossible certificate failure returns exact Base.

localFeedback.source: The frozen D11 bounded local-progress table derived from normalized pre/action/post transitions.
localFeedback.verifiedArm: Wilson-rank coherent procedure trajectories and retain only locally verified actions before external evidence selection.
localFeedback.agnosticAblation: Use FTS-ranked coherent trajectories and all bounded actions; all external selection, evidence, budget, and fallback rules remain identical.
localFeedback.claimGate: Local feedback may be credited only if contexts change, quality is noninferior with zero direct harms versus the agnostic arm, and mean injected tokens do not increase versus that arm.
localFeedback.evolutionBoundary: Only the bounded transition-feedback table, coherent trajectory choice, verified action subset, and one-candidate novel-evidence organization evolve. FTS5, embeddings, raw indexing, extraction model, questions, answers, and Base are unchanged.

forbiddenRuntimeInputs: development, validation, or test phase labels

directMetric.definition: Lower-case, normalize hyphens, punctuation, and whitespace, split phrase-set reference answers by the frozen evaluator separators, and measure exact whole-atom occurrence in injected memory. English action counts match only the explicit Observed source action count field.
directMetric.orderedSecondary: For ordered phrase questions, all normalized atoms must occur in reference order within one delivered memory unit.
directMetric.scopeWarning: This is representation-level support evidence, not answer accuracy, gold evidence recall, or a real programming-task conclusion.

aggregation.bootstrap: paired stratified question bootstrap by domain

phaseAdmission.development: Every phase gate check must pass before validation baseline is read.
phaseAdmission.validation: Every phase gate check must pass before test baseline is read.
phaseAdmission.test: Every phase gate check must pass before any answer-level experiment is admitted.
phaseAdmission.failure: A failed phase rejects D12 confirmation on this frozen protocol. Any follow-up must use a new version and cannot reuse unread phases as development data.

portability.datasetAdapter: LongTaskDatasetAdapter supplies questions, trajectories, and public provenance. An internal programming adapter supplies the same neutral interfaces.
portability.evidenceAdapter: SourceEvidenceAdapter exposes bounded semantic values. A programming adapter may expose exact diagnostics, test failures, diff hunks, file or symbol names, configuration values, and constraints.
portability.unchangedLogic: Candidate ownership, novelty ranking, one-item capacity, certificates, switches, decision logs, phase gates, and hard fallback are schema-independent.

selfOptimization.postFreezeChangesAllowed: bug fixes that preserve exact candidate decisions on frozen design artifacts; any decision-changing change requires a protocol version bump and fresh baselines
selfOptimization.claimBoundary: A development pass is not confirmation; validation and untouched test must independently pass the same frozen gates.
